notes: Reviewed corpus after human review: 971 rows survive (29 AI-flagged rows were rejected by the reviewer and dropped by `ml.review merge --drop-rejected`). Original WS2 generation produced 1000 drafts (450 question, 350 report, 200 safety; 600 en-HK, 400 zh-HK) across 15 Hong Kong role families; 15% of rows carry a second independent review (148 rows). At effective batch 16 the 790 training rows give about 49 optimizer steps/epoch, so eval/save every 10 and log every 2 keep the loss curve readable. Review, hash, deduplication and split gates remain mandatory. num_train_epochs is 1, not 3: the first Kaggle run measured 310 s per optimizer step on a T4 (rows average about 1,800 tokens, so 16 accumulated micro-batches per step), which puts three epochs at roughly 13 hours against a 12-hour session cap. One epoch is 50 steps, about 4.5 hours, and still gives the format, language and citation contract the adapter is for.
